=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Compare the audit scope with the snapshot contents. Provide oversized scoped files through bounded chunks, or fail the audit closed; never record a clean result while scoped files are omitted.
  Expected change site: scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py export_oversized around lines 299-310 (the scoped loop in the function introduced by this PR).
  Evidence of absence: Line 300 `if not readonly_allowed(name): continue` silently drops any scoped file that fails the credential/hidden filter (e.g. CLAUDE.md, .env, secret.json, or a tracked symlink to an oversized target) without recording it as either a `scoped` export or an `unscoped_oversized` coverage entry. The PR's own test `test_export_oversized_chunks_only_scoped_safe_tracked_files` codifies this behavior — the scope file passes `secret.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `large-link.txt` plus `large.txt`, but the assertion is `"scoped=1" in proc.stderr and "unscoped=2" in proc.stderr`, with no observability for the three filtered scoped entries. The audit then proceeds and can record a clean result while those scoped files were never inspected, which directly violates the issue's "never record a clean result while scoped files are omitted" recommendation. The fix the minimax pass 1 reviewer proposed (track filtered scoped names in a third list surfaced as a coverage note) is the missing piece.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Compare the audit scope with the snapshot contents. Provide oversized scoped files through bounded chunks.
  Expected change site: scripts/security_audit.sh lines 1250-1255 (the OVERSIZED_SCOPE_FILE population block introduced by this PR) together with the prior-finding and fix-cycle scope unions at lines 910-913 and 1133-1136.
  Evidence of absence: The new block populates OVERSIZED_SCOPE_FILE only in incremental mode by copying CHANGED_FILES_FILE; prior-finding and fix-cycle files are unioned into CHANGED_FILES_FILE only when AUDIT_SCOPE_MODE=incremental (lines 910-913, 1133-1136), so in a full audit OVERSIZED_SCOPE_FILE is empty and any oversized prior-finding or fix-cycle file is classified as `unscoped_oversized` rather than exported as a scoped chunk. Per AD-2 the prior-finding/fix-cycle files are still "explicit scope" even in full audits, so the audit can record clean on a file the model never read. The minimum fix is to also union PRIOR_FINDINGS_SCOPE_FILE and FIX_CYCLE_DIFFS_SCOPE_FILE into OVERSIZED_SCOPE_FILE outside the incremental guard when those files are non-empty, mirroring what the incremental path already does for CHANGED_FILES_FILE.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: CLI usage message must list every supported subcommand so an operator who mistypes a command gets accurate guidance.
  Expected change site: scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py main() usage string around line 781-783.
  Evidence of absence: The usage string `print("usage: codex_isolated_workspace.py <snapshot-readonly|snapshot-workspace|prep-finalize|transfer|seed-git|copy-include> ARGS", file=sys.stderr)` predates the export-oversized subcommand this PR adds and was not updated; the arity dict one line later does include `"export-oversized": 5`. An operator who passes an invalid subcommand now sees a usage message that omits the very command the PR ships.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
